title: Gaza satellite imagery — 197,000 buildings damaged/destroyed (80%), UNOSAT Sentinel-1 damage analysis
snippet: High-resolution satellite pictures captured Feb 25, 2026 expose landscape where entire neighbourhoods reduced to ash. Google's May 22, 2026 satellite update documents Khan Younis/Rafah aftermath in unprecedented detail. UNOSAT Copernicus Sentinel-1 analysis estimates 197,000 buildings damaged/destroyed — approximately 80% of Gaza structures. 94% of cemeteries destroyed.
tag_reason: 이전 소스에 동일 항목 없음. UNOSAT Sentinel-1 SAR 데이터 기반 포괄적 피해 평가(197,000건 건물)는 신규 수치 제공. 위성 출처(Copernicus Sentinel-1) 명시. 인도주의 도메인 신규 이벤트.
